abstract: The records of 15 patients with Stage B3 or B2/C germ cell testis tumors who underwent full surgical debulking of a residual mass after completion of chemotherapy were reviewed retrospectively to look for predictors of residual mass histology. The density, character, and change in volume of the retroperitoneal mass on computerized tomography before and after chemotherapy were compared with the histology in the primary tumor and in the residual mass. One of 6 patients without teratoma in the primary tumor had a 97 percent reduction in the mass which contained residual teratoma. Two patients with residual seminoma had a 50 percent decrease in tumor volume, and both patients died of tumor progression despite salvage chemotherapy. Two patients with pure seminomas had only residual fibrosis in masses that decreased in volume by 77 and 75 percent, respectively. One of these masses was discrete and the other was diffuse. Seven of 9 patients (78%) with teratoma in the primary tumor had either teratoma (4 of 9, 44%) or carcinoma (3 of 9, 33%) in the residual mass, and the change in mass volume ranged from a 93 percent decrease to a 540 percent increase in size. All 7 patients with residual teratoma and/or carcinoma remain free of disease after observation or further chemotherapy. For the entire series, the mass density and character did not correlate consistently with the primary tumor or residual mass histology. Residual fibrosis alone or teratoma and/or carcinoma were seen with least (0 to 50%) and greatest (more than 90%) decreases in mass volume.
abstract_ja: 進行精巣がん（病期B3またはB2/C）の胚細胞腫瘍患者15例について、化学療法後に外科的減量術で残存腫瘤を切除された症例の記録を後方視的に検討した。化学療法前後の後腹膜腫瘤のCT所見（密度、性状、体積変化）と、原発巣および残存腫瘤の組織像を比較した。原発巣に奇形腫がなかった6例のうち1例で、97%縮小した腫瘤に残存奇形腫が認められた。残存セミノーマの2例では腫瘍体積が50%減少したが、いずれも救援化学療法にもかかわらず腫瘍進行で死亡した。純粋セミノーマの2例では、77%および75%縮小した腫瘤に残存線維化のみが認められた（一方は境界明瞭、他方はびまん性）。原発巣に奇形腫を有した9例のうち7例（78%）では、残存腫瘤に奇形腫（4例、44%）または癌（3例、33%）が認められ、腫瘤体積の変化は93%の縮小から540%の増大までの範囲であった。残存奇形腫および/または癌を有した7例は、経過観察またはさらなる化学療法の後、全例無病生存中である。全体として、腫瘤の密度や性状は原発巣または残存腫瘤の組織像と一貫して相関しなかった。残存線維化のみ、または奇形腫および/または癌は、それぞれ腫瘤体積の縮小が最も少ない（0〜50%）場合と最も多い（90%超）場合に認められた。
